name: rtk
description: Installs the rtk (Rust Token Killer) token-optimizing CLI proxy into /usr/local/bin, and optionally wires it into the coding agents present in the container.

rtkVersion.description: rtk version to install ('latest' or a release tag such as v0.45.0).

init.description: Which agents to wire rtk into for the remote user. 'auto' wires up whichever of claude / opencode is on PATH.
